note: From the South Carolina Election Commission's candidate listing (active candidates for Greenwood County) and referendum listing for the November 3, 2026 Statewide General Election. Not shown: the Soil and Water District Commission race (Brad Martin and Andrew Warner; the number of seats could not be confirmed from an official source), County Council Districts 1, 2 and 3, school board seats (Districts 1, 2, 5 unexpired, 6 and 8), the Greenwood School District 50 bond referendum (up to $175 million; only voters in District 50 vote on it), and State House and U.S. House districts. Municipal contests, including the City of Greenwood's, are not covered because municipal filings are not in the state listing. Incumbent flags are not set because the county's own officeholder pages were not checked. Check your official sample ballot for the full list.
